initialPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, polished website UI mockup. Create ONE refined hybrid version of the supplied Pets4Luv homepage based on an expert design review. Image 1 is the serif reference for elegant display headlines. Image 2 is the sans-serif reference and main layout/edit target. Both depict the same approved homepage. Keep its exact layout, burgundy/ivory colors, original logo artwork, hero photography (golden dog and tabby cat lying immediately side by side), hero copy, filter controls, integrated chat below filters, weekly animal spotlight, footer, and floating chat launcher. Make ONLY the following typography and usability refinements.
TYPOGRAPHY: Use the elegant serif display type of image 1 for ONLY the main hero headline 'Every animal deserves a next chapter.' and weekly story headline 'Some love stories take a little longer.' These are the two expressive storytelling moments. All other website text uses the clean modern sans-serif of image 2: navigation, Donate, hero subtitle 'Help them find theirs.', search heading 'Find your furry best friend', View all animals, segmented All pets/Cats/Dogs tabs, Age and Size labels and values, buttons, inline chat text, animal names, descriptions, captions, small section labels, and footer. Keep these sans-serif texts upright/nonitalic for clear scanning. Use semibold for functional headings and buttons, regular for descriptions/help text. Maintain generous line spacing and clear hierarchy. The two serif headlines should be beautiful and warm, not oversize to the point of crowding or obscuring the animal faces. The logo itself is an image and MUST NOT be changed or typeset anew.
CHAT LABEL: Preserve the separator 'OR tell us what you’re looking for' in upright readable sans-serif under the filters. Add a small burgundy chat icon and visible semibold label 'Ask Pets4Luv' directly ABOVE the chat input, left-aligned. Keep placeholder EXACTLY 'Tell us about your ideal companion' in regular upright sans-serif. Keep the Send button and helper sentence 'You can also ask about adoption, pet care, or volunteering.' The inline label must visually connect this input to the existing floating Ask Pets4Luv launcher. Give this added label appropriate vertical spacing; allow the panel and page to grow slightly if needed. Search/chat panel has thin subtle border and NO SHADOW. Do not add another chat band below weekly animals.
LUNA LINK: The large Luna photograph currently ends in a burgundy caption strip. Preserve 'Luna • This week’s spotlight' in clear sans-serif on the LEFT of that strip. Add a distinct white underlined 'Meet Luna →' link on its RIGHT, with enough space and contrast; slightly reduce caption text size if needed so nothing collides. It must be a clearly visible navigation action, comparable to the Milo and Olive links.
Keep all prior requirements: no Meet the animals hero button; cat and dog beside each other; no search container drop shadow; warm cinematic hero; original masthead; exact short chat placeholder. Preserve sample-animal disclaimer. No added statistics, new sections, fake messages, browser chrome or device frames. Full-page straight-on desktop screenshot, same approximate width and aspect as reference, legible text and no clipping.
